title: Object Storage: availability target percentage
content:
Object Storage availability target percentage is defined as follows: Monthly availability percentage above which no outage credit is due; decimal.

| Contract tier | Availability target percentage |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | availability target percentage: 99.9 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | availability target percentage: 99.9 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | availability target percentage: 99.9 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | availability target percentage: 99.9 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | availability target percentage: 99.9 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | availability target percentage: 99.9 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the availability target percentage entry is 99.9.
